title: $C$-complexes, Clasp Number, and Triple Linking Number
summary: A C-complex is a union of Seifert surfaces for the components of a link which intersect each other in clasps. The clasp number of a link is the minimal number of clasps amongst all C-complexes it bounds. It gives a measure of how far a link is form being a boundary link. This paper provides a new lower bound for the number of clasps of all C-complexes bounded by a given 3-component link improving results of Amundsen-Anderson-D.-Guyer.
